# isandburn.github.io

> Machine-first personal site. Built for AI agents and the owner — not for
> general web browsing. Prefer the markdown files below over the HTML.

## Agent entry points

- [skills.md](/skills.md) — catalog of agent skills: versions, checksums, install
- [code.md](/code.md) — the rotating code block (pointer to the raw source)

## Sources of truth

- [code_block_content.txt](/code_block_content.txt) — raw text served by the home page code card
- [skills/](/skills/) — published skill packages (versioned zips)

## Conventions

- Markdown twins describe and link; they never duplicate volatile content.
- Skills are published as versioned zips (`<name>-<version>.zip`) with a `.sha256`
  sidecar and a latest copy (`<name>.zip`).
- Release facts (version, checksum, versioned archive) live only in [skills.md](/skills.md).
- This file is a stable front door: it lists areas, not individual skills.
